title: GenAI Hub - Model Operations
description: Operational command centre for the GenAI Hub model gateway. Deployment-level reliability, latency and token economics, filterable by deployment and consumer.

list.name: deployment
list.label: Model deployment
list.description: Filter every panel to one or more model deployments.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s))
| where isnotempty(Dep)
| distinct Dep
| order by Dep asc

list.name: consumer
list.label: Consumer
list.description: Filter to specific APIM subscriptions (consuming applications).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs'
| distinct Consumer=tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s)
| where isnotempty(Consumer)
| order by Consumer asc

panels.title: Gateway Availability
panels.description: Share of gateway calls not returning 5xx, over the selected window. Green at or above 99.9%.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| summarize Total=count(), Bad=countif(responseCode_d >= 500) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| project TimeGenerated, Availability = 100.0 * (Total - Bad) / Total
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Total gateway calls in the selected window.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| summarize Requests=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Client Error Rate
panels.description: Percentage of calls returning 4xx or 5xx. Includes gateway-side rejections.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| summarize Total=count(), Bad=countif(responseCode_d >= 400) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| project TimeGenerated, ErrorRate = 100.0 * Bad / Total
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: P95 Latency
panels.description: 95th percentile end-to-end gateway duration, averaged across buckets.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| summarize P95=percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Tokens Processed
panels.description: Total LLM tokens billed through the gateway (GatewayLlmLogs). Only providers that emit LLM logs are counted.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where Category == 'GatewayLlmLogs'
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or tostring(deploymentName_s) in (${deployment:singlequote})
| summarize Tokens=sum(totalTokens_d) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Failing Deployments
panels.description: Deployments where more than 90% of calls fail. Any value above zero means a model route is effectively down.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| summarize Total=count(), Bad=countif(responseCode_d >= 400) by Dep
| where Total >= 20 and (100.0 * Bad / Total) > 90
| summarize Broken=count()

panels.title: Model Deployment Health
panels.description: Per-deployment traffic, reliability and latency. Sorted by call volume. Error Rate is colour-graded; anything at 100% is a fully broken route.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| summarize Calls=count(), Errors=countif(responseCode_d >= 400), ServerErrors=countif(responseCode_d >= 500), P50=round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)), P95=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) by Dep
| extend ErrorRate = round(100.0 * Errors / Calls, 2), Availability = round(100.0 * (Calls - ServerErrors) / Calls, 3)
| project Deployment=Dep, Calls, ErrorRate, Availability, P50, P95, Errors
| order by Calls desc

value.title: Routing and failover for this deployment

panels.title: Response Classes
panels.description: Gateway responses grouped by HTTP status class, stacked to show composition of traffic.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| extend Code = toint(responseCode_d)
| extend Class = case(Code >= 500, '5xx server', Code >= 400, '4xx client', Code >= 300, '3xx redirect', Code >= 200, '2xx success', 'other')
| summarize Requests=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Class
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Latency Percentiles
panels.description: P50, P95 and P99 end-to-end gateway duration. Divergence between P50 and P99 indicates tail-latency problems.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| summarize P50=percentile(DurationMs, 50), P95=percentile(DurationMs, 95), P99=percentile(DurationMs, 99) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Throttling (429)
panels.description: Rate-limited calls. Sustained 429s mean consumers are exceeding their quota or backend capacity is short.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| where responseCode_d == 429
| summarize Throttled=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Consumer=tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Backend vs Gateway Time
panels.description: Average time spent in the model backend compared with total gateway duration. A widening gap points at gateway-side overhead.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| summarize ['Backend time']=avg(backendTime_d), ['Total gateway time']=avg(DurationMs) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Token Throughput by Deployment
panels.description: Total tokens per interval, split by model deployment. Sourced from GatewayLlmLogs.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where Category == 'GatewayLlmLogs'
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or tostring(deploymentName_s) in (${deployment:singlequote})
| summarize Tokens=sum(totalTokens_d) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Deployment=tostring(deploymentName_s)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Prompt vs Completion Tokens
panels.description: Split of input against generated tokens. A rising completion share usually means longer answers and higher cost per call.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where Category == 'GatewayLlmLogs'
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or tostring(deploymentName_s) in (${deployment:singlequote})
| summarize Prompt=sum(promptTokens_d), Completion=sum(completionTokens_d), Cached=sum(promptCachedTokens_d), Reasoning=sum(completionReasoningTokens_d) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Token Economics by Deployment
panels.description: Per-deployment token totals with prompt-cache hit rate and streaming adoption. Cache hit rate above zero directly reduces spend.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where Category == 'GatewayLlmLogs'
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or tostring(deploymentName_s) in (${deployment:singlequote})
| summarize Calls=count(), Total=sum(totalTokens_d), Prompt=sum(promptTokens_d), Completion=sum(completionTokens_d), Cached=sum(promptCachedTokens_d), Reasoning=sum(completionReasoningTokens_d), Streamed=countif(isStreamCompletion_b == true) by Deployment=tostring(deploymentName_s)
| extend ['Cache hit %'] = round(100.0 * Cached / iff(Prompt == 0, 1.0, Prompt), 2), ['Streaming %'] = round(100.0 * Streamed / Calls, 1), ['Tokens per call'] = round(Total / Calls)
| project Deployment, Calls, Total, ['Tokens per call'], Prompt, Completion, Reasoning, ['Cache hit %'], ['Streaming %']
| order by Total desc

value.title: Routing and failover for this deployment

panels.title: Consumer Health
panels.description: Traffic and reliability per APIM subscription. Use this to tell platform-wide incidents apart from a single misbehaving consumer.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| summarize Calls=count(), Errors=countif(responseCode_d >= 400), Throttled=countif(responseCode_d == 429), P95=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) by Consumer=tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s), Product=tostring(productId_s)
| extend ['Error %'] = round(100.0 * Errors / Calls, 2)
| project Consumer, Product, Calls, ['Error %'], Throttled, P95
| order by Calls desc

panels.title: Gateway Rejection Reasons
panels.description: Calls the gateway rejected before reaching a model backend. A blank backend code with a 4xx means the request never left APIM, usually a routing or policy fault.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT' and Category == 'GatewayLogs' | extend Dep = extract(@'/deployments/([^/?]+)', 1, tostring(url_s)) | where isnotempty(Dep)
| where '*' in (${deployment:singlequote}) or Dep in (${deployment:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${consumer:singlequote}) or tostring(apimSubscriptionId_s) in (${consumer:singlequote})
| where responseCode_d >= 400
| extend BackendCode = toint(coalesce(backendResponseCode_d, real(0)))
| summarize Calls=count() by Deployment=Dep, ResponseCode=toint(responseCode_d), BackendCode, Reason=tostring(column_ifexists('lastError_reason_s', 'not recorded'))
| order by Calls desc | take 30
